versions.changelog:
nerua1-setup-guide 1.0.1

- Initial changelog and project story files added for transparency and project history (PUBLISHED.md, STORY.md).
- SKILL.md updated: "RAM reality" section improved to clarify why cloud orchestrator is recommended at 32GB and to better explain trade-offs between local and cloud LLM setups.
- Examples and recommendations for orchestrator and subagent combinations were modernized for current model/API quality and pricing.
- Wording and critical DO NOT advice in "lobotomy protection" clarified and safety/restore instructions updated.
- Minor edits for clarity and consistency throughout the guide.

Initial release of the OpenClaw + Claude Code setup guide with real-world insights for Mac Mini M4.

- Details a recommended install order (start with Claude Code for recovery options).
- Outlines RAM limitations and setup options for 32GB and 64GB systems.
- Highlights critical pitfalls including dangers of `openclaw doctor --repair`, lobotomy scenarios, and issues with sandbox mode.
- Documents the shared memory architecture (Obsidian + MemPalace), communication between agents, and WhatsApp console integration.
- Includes best practices for backups, recovery procedures, and a decision framework for safe operations and escalation.
